info.name: Moover Complete API & Route Collection
info.description: Complete collection for every registered Moover route. {{base_url}} is the application origin and {{api_url}} resolves to {{base_url}}/api. Authenticated requests inherit Bearer {{token}}. Login requests automatically save returned tokens. File-upload requests use multipart form-data with selectable file fields. Destructive requests are disabled by default.
